meta.subject: Dan Vogel
meta.description: A professional knowledge graph about Dan Vogel. Nodes are entities (person, jobs, education, projects, activities, essays, skills, locations) and edges are relationships between them. Used to ground answers to questions about Dan.

nodes.label: Dan Vogel
nodes.summary: Dan Vogel is a Senior Software Engineer at Capital One in Richmond, VA, and a Yale School of Management MBA graduate. He previously worked at Google. He enjoys building software, writing, his book club, being outside, and playing guitar. He is always open to projects that help him grow as an engineer and as a person.

nodes.label: Senior Software Engineer, Capital One (Card Tech)
nodes.summary: At Capital One (Jan 2026 - present, Card Tech), Dan is building an AI-powered CD (continuous delivery) platform to automate aspects of software delivery, such as GitHub code reviews and Jenkins build pipeline diagnoses. The platform supports twenty different dev teams.

nodes.label: MBA, Yale School of Management
nodes.summary: Dan earned an MBA at Yale School of Management (2023 - 2025). He described it as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that gave him his spark back after growing comfortable in the working world. At Yale he joined a GovTech startup in the Yale Accelerator, took several writing classes, and bikepacked solo across the United States over summer break.

nodes.label: Software Engineer, Google Cloud Serverless
nodes.summary: At Google Cloud (Oct 2019 - Mar 2023, Serverless team, San Francisco), Dan worked on serverless infrastructure including Serverless VPC Access Connectors. At Google he grew from a junior engineer who needed guidance into someone who could identify and scope engineering projects on his own and mentor more junior engineers.

nodes.label: Software Engineer, Google+
nodes.summary: At Google (Oct 2018 - Oct 2019, Google+ team, Sunnyvale), Dan started on the Google+ team. He arrived for his first day of orientation excited to join Google+ when he learned via a news article that Google was shutting Google+ down.

nodes.label: Software Engineer, Capital One (early)
nodes.summary: At Capital One (Jun 2016 - Aug 2018, Core Engineering then Capital One Labs, San Francisco), Dan experienced a large corporate environment for the first time. In his first year he evangelized an internal product, building marketing materials, speaking at conferences, and running workshops. In his second year he specialized in maintaining cloud infrastructure, where he realized the power of the cloud, which informed his goal to join Google Cloud.

nodes.label: BookClurb
nodes.summary: BookClurb is an open-source platform for managing book clubs, built by Dan. It is built with React, Go, Firebase, and Cloud Run. Demo at bookclurb.net and source on GitHub at github.com/dhvogel/bookclurb.

nodes.label: Solo bikepacking across the United States
nodes.summary: During summer break in business school, Dan bikepacked solo across the United States. He has written about how bicycling across the U.S. relates to software engineering.

nodes.label: Stand-up comedy
nodes.summary: In 2023, Dan did open-mic stand-up comedy every day for a year. He described it as a humbling time that taught him a few things.

nodes.label: Book club
nodes.summary: Outside of work Dan participates in his book club. His interest in book clubs also inspired his BookClurb project.
